test_page.test_error_boundaries_description: This page allows you to test various error boundary scenarios. Click the buttons below to trigger different types of errors.
test_page.test_error_boundaries_warning: This page is only available in development mode.
test_page.test_error_boundaries_section_1_title: 1. Component Render Error (Caught by Error Boundary)
test_page.test_error_boundaries_section_1_descript: This error is thrown during component render and will be caught by the error boundary.
test_page.test_error_boundaries_section_2_title: 2. Error in useEffect (Caught by Error Boundary)
test_page.test_error_boundaries_section_2_descript: This error is thrown in useEffect and will be caught by the error boundary.
test_page.test_error_boundaries_section_3_descript: This error is thrown conditionally based on state and will be caught by the error boundary.
test_page.test_error_boundaries_section_4_title: 4. Event Handler Error (NOT Caught by Error Boundary)
test_page.test_error_boundaries_section_4_descript: Errors in event handlers are NOT caught by error boundaries. This will show in the console.
test_page.test_error_boundaries_section_5_descript: This will trigger the Next.js route-level error page (error.tsx).
test_page.test_error_boundaries_section_6_descript: Test nested error boundaries - inner boundary catches error, outer continues to work.

profile.sharable_status_public_description: Your profile is visible to everyone and can be found in public profile listings.

notifications.web_push_help: Receive browser notifications for new episodes and tracks for creators you subscribe to. Works in supported browsers.
notifications.unified_push_help: Use Unified Push to receive notifications through a compatible push service (like ntfy). Requires a Unified Push endpoint URL.
notifications.up_endpoint_info: Enter your Unified Push endpoint URL. Compatible with ntfy and other UP services.
notifications.up_auth_key_info: Required for private/protected topics. Leave empty for public topics.
notifications.up_enable_error: Failed to enable Unified Push. Please check your endpoint URL.
notifications.default_new-item_help: Receive notifications when new episodes or tracks are published from creators you subscribe to. This is the default notification setting that applies to all your subscriptions, but can be overridden for each.
notifications.default_livestream-scheduled_help: Receive notifications when livestreams are scheduled from creators you subscribe to. This is the default notification setting that applies to all your subscriptions, but can be overridden for each.
notifications.default_livestream-started_help: Receive notifications when livestreams start from creators you subscribe to. This is the default notification setting that applies to all your subscriptions, but can be overridden for each.

terms.never_sell_data: Podverse will never sell or share private user data.
terms.no_ads_without_permission: We will never put advertisements next to or within a podcast's content without that podcast's permission.
terms.audio_video_hosting: All audio or video files found on podverse.fm load from the podcaster's own public server. We do not host podcast audio or video files ourselves.
terms.third_party_feeds: We host podcast links and content from third-party podcast feeds and sites. These have their own independent privacy policies, and we have no responsibility for their content or activities.
terms.clips_crowdsourced: All clips hosted on podverse.fm are crowd-sourced and unofficial, unless otherwise noted by the podcaster themselves.
terms.clips_load_full_episode: Clips load within the full episode's media file, so the user always has access to the full recording.
terms.reduced_size_images: We also host reduced size podcast images from podcasters' feeds, to save user network data and speed up page loading times.
